hits.s: of the run lowered to 187. Downlinks were successful for most of the run. The last 300m some downlinks had to be re-taken of bottom due to “Timed out”. At TD, downlinked “Home” command to GP. While taking Up/Down weight observed overpull. Rotated with 40 rpm but string stalled out. Continued to torque up to 34kNm to free pipe. Gradually increased RPM to 140 and reciprocated the pipe. On one occasion, at 4319.5m, a pack off and rotary stall was seen requiring +65T overpull to free the assembly. At this point the decision was made to pull out of hole and check the BHA.

1.5° Inclination less than the parent hole, which implied that the sidetrack had been successfully started in the clean out section. At 4333.5m rotary stall was seen which required the assembly to be pulled back in shoe with 65T overpull.
